title: Villa Chac Hal Al
subtitle: Chac Hal Al
description:
Commanding a privileged position within the prestigious Chac Hal Al community on the calm waters of Fatima Bay, this extraordinary beachfront villa offers a front-row seat to the Caribbean Sea. It is a rare convergence of quiet luxury, immediate marina access, and outstanding investment potential.

Spanning 3,714 sq ft of thoughtfully crafted space, the residence is designed to erase the boundaries between indoors and out. The main level centers around a sun-drenched living and dining area, framed by panoramic windows that invite the ocean inside. A fully equipped kitchen with a welcoming bar area flows naturally onto the private terrace and manicured gardens,  the perfect setting for hosting with the Caribbean as your backdrop. A dedicated service patio with staff quarters ensures seamless daily living.

The upper levels are dedicated to absolute rest and privacy. The second floor hosts three generous bedrooms, each featuring en-suite bathrooms, where private balconies and expansive windows offer daily awakenings to the rhythm of the waves. A versatile top floor reveals a fourth bedroom and full bathroom, serving beautifully as an independent guest suite or a private studio.

The transition from home to ocean is effortless. Residents enjoy exclusive amenities including a beachfront pool, shaded palapas, and direct beach access, all safeguarded by controlled entry and 24/7 security. Located just a short stroll from the vibrant marina, fine dining, and the golf course, this villa is not a compromise, it is the ultimate expression of the Riviera Maya lifestyle.
highlights: Direct beachfront location with private condominium beach
3,714 sq ft construction with spacious functional areas
Main living room with panoramic sea windows
Private terraces with garden and Caribbean views
Close to the marina, restaurants, and golf course
